No main-file promotion based solely on a point estimate; Wilson lower below75 means the >75 claim remains unvalidated.
Any individually surviving rules require simultaneous prequota full-portfolio replay before combined results.
Continue disclosing 220 prior and 160 new comparisons even when a rule looks attractive.
